            try:

                if status == 200 and value.get('ok') is True:

            except (OSError, ValueError):

            time.sleep(0.05)
        raise AssertionError('server /health did not become ready')

            self.process = None
        if self.log is not None:

        selected = dict(headers or {})

            return response.status, value
        finally:
